player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id}. Wo reko Guess The Number.
Wo haw sɛ wo bɛto dwom no wɔ {min_number} ne {max_number} ntam wɔ {max_turns} berɛ mu.
Sɛ wo de wo bɔtoɔ kɔ, agorɔ no bɛma wo nkyerɛkyerɛmu te sɛ 'kɔ soro' anaa 'kɔ fam'.
Wo betumi de wo bɔtoɔ ama wɔ kwan biara. Nokware, nambari a ɛwɔ square brackets mu no nko ara na yɛbɛgye tom sɛ wo bɔtoɔ. Sɛ nhwɛso, [5].
Sɛ wo reko no, abakɔsɛm a ɛfa wo bɔtoɔ ho no bɛka ho ase. Fa mfidie no so na wo dwom no ansa na wo bɔtoɔ ahwe ase.
Kɔka wo bɔtoɔ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nkyerɛwdeɛ a ɛyɛ mũ a wɔde bɛba no yɛ saa. Osei {player_id} ampene soa '[number]' a ɛfata.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nkɔso a enni mu. Odifo {player_id} kaa biribi wɔ baabi foforo na ɛnka nea wɔahyɛ ato hɔ no ho.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Nkɔso a enni mu. Odifo {player_id} adi kan ahu nea ɛyɛ ne de dedaw.

game_message.target_higher: Wɔn a wɔrepɛ wɔn akum no dɔɔso.
game_message.target_lower: Nhyehyɛe a wɔde sii wɔn ani so no yɛ ketewa.

outcome.turn_limit: Ɛberɛ a wɔakɔ so no akɔ so. Guess: {guess}, Target: {target}
